resources.string: Check your body mass index in seconds

Body mass index (BMI) is calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in metres squared. For adults, this app uses the Asian BMI ranges introduced in the assignment. For ages 6–18, it uses age- and gender-specific BMI charts. BMI is a screening measure and is not a medical diagnosis.
Please enter both height and weight.
Height and weight must be greater than zero.
Please enter an age from 6 to 120. The child chart covers ages 6-18.
The BMI is at or below the 3rd percentile for this age and gender. Please consult a healthcare professional for an individual assessment.
The BMI is below the recommended range. Aim for balanced nutrition and seek professional advice if concerned.
The BMI is within the acceptable range. Keep up healthy eating and regular physical activity.
The BMI is above the recommended range. Consider balanced meals and regular physical activity.
The adult BMI is 25 or above. Consider discussing healthy weight goals with a healthcare professional.
The BMI is at or above the 97th percentile for this age and gender. Please consult a healthcare professional for an individual assessment.
